title: Directed acyclic graph of a layered circuit
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits that uses only identity, negation, and unbounded fan-in conjunction gates. Its associated directed acyclic graph circuit has the gates obtained from all layers in order, with each gate reading only earlier vertices, and has as output the vertex corresponding to the circuit’s final output.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ uses only the standard gate operations
